deployments_detail.use: inVue Dx AI cellular analyzer (deep-learning models, ref-lab quality in 10 min) + AI diagnostic imaging/radiology

SediVue Dx in-clinic urine sediment analyzer uses proprietary convolutional Neural Network software (Neural Network 6.0), trained on 800M+ patient images, to classify and count formed elements and detect bacteria in urine sediment in under 3 minutes. [IDEXX proprietary neural network (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: under 3 minutes vs ~20 min manual; 800M+ training images

deployments_detail.use: ProCyte One / ProCyte Dx hematology analyzers use AI-based laser flow cytometry to create digital 'fingerprints' of cells and remove platelet clumps from white blood cell populations, improving CBC accuracy. [IDEXX proprietary (in-house)]

inVue Dx Cellular Analyzer uses deep AI learning models trained by board-certified pathologists on 10M+ patient sample images to perform automated, slide-free cytology and blood morphology analysis with reference-lab accuracy in 10 minutes. [IDEXX proprietary deep learning (in-house)]

IDEXX Web PACS AI-powered advanced viewer — first use of AI in veterinary radiology — automatically corrects image orientation and organizes radiographs by body part with hanging protocols, cutting time to diagnosis. [IDEXX proprietary (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: up to 25% faster from x-ray to diagnosis

deployments_detail.use: IDEXX Web PACS automated Vertebral Heart Score (VHS) tool uses a machine-learning algorithm to identify the heart on thoracic radiographs, apply measurement lines, calculate VHS, and trend results to screen for heart enlargement — validated as comparable to board-certified cardiologists. [IDEXX proprietary ML (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: performance comparable to three board-certified cardiologists (Solomon et al. 2023)

deployments_detail.use: IDEXX DecisionIQ diagnostic decision-support tool (in VetConnect PLUS) leverages AI on patient-specific diagnostic data to identify subtle patterns and detect current or developing disease across renal (IRIS CKD staging), endocrine, and infectious-disease areas; available free to all IDEXX customers. [IDEXX proprietary (in-house)]

ImageVue DR50 Plus digital radiography system pairs with AI-powered Web PACS to automate hanging protocols and vertebral heart scores, plus AI-driven image optimization and automated protocols to reduce retakes, at the lowest radiation dose. [IDEXX proprietary (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: up to 25% lower radiation dose vs prior DR50; 60% less on average vs computed radiography

deployments_detail.use: IDEXX Cancer Dx Panel reportedly uses pattern recognition/AI to flag diagnostic profiles consistent with common neoplasms (e.g., lymphoma markers) in dogs and cats, part of IDEXX's AI-driven diagnostic suite. [IDEXX (third-party reported)]
